approval_record.authority_statement: This approval establishes a governed source baseline for Knowledge Base authoring. It does not establish legal applicability, legal compliance, residual-risk acceptance, or lifecycle authorization.
approval_record.change_control: A changed source identity, authority classification, version, effective status, official location, licensing boundary, or coverage mapping requires a new register version and renewed approval.

authority_boundary: The register owns source identity, authority tier, official location, version and verification metadata. Category objects own exact clause mappings, applicability rationale and assessment-time interpretation. A registered source is not case evidence and cannot independently satisfy a control.

authority_tiers.meaning: Binding legislation, applicable treaty obligations and primary rights instruments. Applicability remains jurisdiction-, role-, use- and date-specific.
Official non-binding guidance, government frameworks, intergovernmental instruments and published standards. These sources support interpretation or assurance but are not legislation.
Recognized community technical guidance. These sources support threat and control design but cannot define legal obligations.

decision_eligible_requirements: The register release status is APPROVED.
The source verification status is VERIFIED.
The source has an official publisher location and an authority classification.
The source is in force or published and is not withdrawn, superseded or under development.
Licensed standards remain metadata- and locator-only unless separate usage rights are recorded.
category_mapping_requirements: Use the registered source ID and version.
Identify an exact article, clause, annex, section or control locator.
State the category-specific mapping rationale and applicability conditions.
Do not infer compliance from the existence of a mapping.
